archetype: Organic & Earthy / High-Contrast Hybrid (Food Manufacturing ERP)

typography.strategy: Professional Utility - Clean hierarchy for dense data environments.

danger.usage: expired batch, negative stock, unpaid debts

sidebar.style: bg-slate-900 border-r border-slate-800 flex-shrink-0 fixed h-full z-40 transition-all duration-300
sidebar.item: flex items-center gap-3 px-4 py-2.5 rounded-md text-sm font-medium transition-colors hover:bg-slate-800 hover:text-white

grids_and_layouts.main_content: flex-1 ml-64 p-6 lg:p-8 min-h-screen w-[calc(100%-16rem)]
grids_and_layouts.kpi_card: col-span-1 bg-white p-6 rounded-lg border border-slate-200 shadow-sm flex flex-col gap-2 hover:-translate-y-0.5 transition-transform

components.strategy: Flat, Crisp, High-Contrast Data UI. Avoid heavy shadows. Use 1px borders.

buttons.primary: bg-emerald-600 text-white hover:bg-emerald-700 px-4 py-2 rounded-md font-medium transition-colors text-sm shadow-sm
buttons.secondary: bg-white text-slate-700 border border-slate-300 hover:bg-slate-50 px-4 py-2 rounded-md font-medium transition-colors text-sm shadow-sm
buttons.danger: bg-rose-600 text-white hover:bg-rose-700 px-4 py-2 rounded-md font-medium transition-colors text-sm shadow-sm

tables.wrapper: w-full overflow-auto bg-white rounded-lg border border-slate-200 shadow-sm
tables.header: bg-slate-50 text-slate-500 text-xs uppercase tracking-wider font-semibold border-b border-slate-200 py-3 px-4 text-left sticky top-0
tables.row: border-b border-slate-100 hover:bg-slate-50 transition-colors group cursor-pointer
tables.cell: py-3 px-4 text-sm text-slate-700 align-middle whitespace-nowrap

forms.input: flex h-10 w-full rounded-md border border-slate-300 bg-white px-3 py-2 text-sm text-slate-900 placeholder:text-slate-400 focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-emerald-500/20 focus:border-emerald-500 transition-all
forms.label: block text-sm font-medium text-slate-700 mb-1.5
forms.layout: For complex ERP data entry (e.g., BOM, Master Data), use Side Drawers (Slide-overs) instead of center modals to maximize vertical space.

components.badges: inline-flex items-center px-2 py-0.5 rounded text-xs font-medium border

icons.style: Stroke width 1.5, slightly muted colors unless active.
icons.usage: Use icons heavily in sidebar, KPI cards, and table actions to improve visual parsing speed.

micro_interactions.table_rows: Subtle bg-slate-50 on hover to track wide rows easily.
micro_interactions.notifications: Bell icon with a pulsing red absolute dot if unread alerts exist (e.g., stock minimum reached).

login_background.description: Modern food manufacturing facility. Use as a half-screen background on the login page with a dark/green gradient overlay (bg-emerald-900/60).

accessibility.contrast: Ensure all text passes WCAG AA. Never use grey text on a grey background for data.
accessibility.testing: All interactive elements (buttons, inputs, menu items, table rows) MUST have a `data-testid` attribute using kebab-case role-based naming (e.g., `data-testid='sidebar-gudang-link'`).
accessibility.focus: All focusable elements must have visible focus rings (`focus:ring-2 focus:ring-emerald-500/20`).

instructions_to_main_agent: Build a custom HTML/Tailwind layout for the Sidebar and Dashboard framing. Avoid wrapping the entire app in generic Shadcn containers.
Use standard `.js` files for React components (not `.tsx`).
Use Shadcn components for complex interactive logic: Dialog/Drawer for CRUD, Select/Combobox for Autocomplete, DropdownMenu for table row actions, Sonner for Toast notifications.
Data Tables are critical: Implement search inputs above tables, distinct column headers, and pagination controls at the bottom.
The app requires a Single Source of Truth feeling: no fragmented UI. Keep spacing tight (px-4 py-3) in tables to view maximum data without scrolling.
Use the specific color status semantics for stock levels (danger for expired, warning for low stock).
For the login page, create a split-screen design. Left side: Login form on white background. Right side: The login_background image with a dark overlay.
Do NOT use complete transparent backgrounds in headers or dropdowns. Ensure solid backgrounds (bg-white) for all floating elements to avoid overlap collision.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: Do not use generic centered layouts or simplistic purple gradients. This is a professional business tool.
Create depth through 1px borders and subtle shadow-sm, not massive drop shadows.
Use glass-morphism (backdrop-blur) only for sticky headers or modals over complex content, otherwise stick to solid white.
DO NOT apply `transition: all` globally. Apply specific transitions like `transition-colors` or `transition-transform`.
DO NOT center align the main app container. Text and data must flow naturally from the left.
Always use modern pill-shaped or slightly rounded buttons (rounded-md) with clear interaction states.
NEVER use emojis as icons. Use lucide-react.
Ensure Sonner toasts are implemented in a root layout for global notifications.
